entries.toelichting: Aramaic Pael; Dan 6:23 'no harm was found upon him'. Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix per principle, distinguished from H2255 chaval-Aram 'corrupt'.
Item taken in security; Eze 18:7,12,16; 33:15. Hyphenated to mark security-object distinct from H2258b chavolah 'borrowed-pledge'.
Sub-sense of chavol; the act-of-pledging or thing-borrowed (Eze 18:7,12,16). Hyphenated to mark loan-aspect.
Qal-participle of chaval (rope-handler); Jonah 1:6 'master-of-the-rope', Eze 27:8,27-29. Hyphenated to mark rope-handling-mariner.
Prov 23:34 'top of mast'; rope-mast complex. Hyphenated to mark ship's-pole-with-rigging aspect.
Bulb-flower of plain (Song 2:1; Isa 35:1). Hyphenated to mark bulb-flower-of-plain; KJV 'rose' is botanically incorrect — Hebrew names a crocus or narcissus, not the modern rose (a Latin loan).
Ancestor of Rechabites (Jer 35:3). English convention: Habazziniah.
Qal/Pi: hold-close-in-arms (Gen 29:13; 33:4; 48:10; Eze 3:5; 2Kgs 4:16; Ecc 3:5; 4:5; Job 24:8; Prov 4:8; 5:20; Lam 4:5).
Prov 6:10; 24:33 'a-little-folding-of-the-hands-to-sleep'. Hyphenated to mark idle-clasp distinct from H2263 chavaq embrace-action.
Prophet whose name is intensive of chavaq (embracer); Hab 1:1; 3:1. English convention: Habakkuk.
Qal/Pi/Pu/Hith: be-allied, joined-together, ally-oneself (Gen 14:3; Ex 26:6; 28:7; 39:4; 2Chr 20:35,36,37; Eze 1:9,11; Hos 4:17; Ps 94:20; Dan 11:6,23). Standard concordant 'join'.
Magical-binding-formula (Deut 18:11; Isa 47:9,12; Ps 58:6). Hyphenated to mark binding-spell-aspect; from chavar 'join/bind' in incantation-sense.
Multiple persons including Asherite (Gen 46:17), Kenite husband of Jael (Judg 4:11,17,21; 5:24), Judahite (1Chr 4:18), Benjamites (1Chr 8:17,22). English convention: Heber.
Aramaic-noun for fellow/colleague (Dan 2:13,17,18). Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix; cognate of Heb H2270 chaver.
Allied-fellow (Judg 20:11; Ps 45:8; 119:63; Prov 28:24; Ecc 4:10; Song 1:7; 8:13; Isa 1:23; 44:11; Eze 37:16,19). Standard concordant 'companion'.
Job 41:6 'partners-divide-him'. Hyphenated to mark trading-association distinct from H2270 chaver companion.
Jer 13:23 'can-Cushite-change-skin or-leopard-his-spots'. Hyphenated reduplicated stem expresses pattern-of-marks.
Aramaic feminine of chaver; Dan 7:20 'his-fellow-horns'. Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix.
Job 34:8 'company-with-workers-of-iniquity'. Hyphenated to mark associative-band distinct from H2270 chaver individual.
Levite descendant of Kohath (Ex 6:18; Num 3:19,27; 26:58; 1Chr 6:2,18; 15:9; 23:12,19). Hyphenated to distinguish Levitical-person from H2275a place-name.
Gentilic of Hebron-II (Num 3:27; 26:58; 1Chr 26:23,30,31). English convention: Hebronite.
Gentilic of Heber the Asherite (Num 26:45). English convention: Heberite.
Tabernacle-curtain coupling-piece (Ex 26:4,10; 36:11,17). Hyphenated to mark joined-pair-section distinct from H2279 chovereth.
Tabernacle/ephod-coupling fastener (Ex 26:4,10; 28:27; 39:20). Hyphenated to mark fastening-clasp distinct from H2278 chaveret curtain-section.
Qal/Pi/Pu: bind on (saddle Gen 22:3; turban Ex 29:9; Lev 8:13), wound-bind (Isa 1:6; 30:26; 61:1; Eze 30:21; Ps 147:3; Job 5:18). Hyphenated to mark binding-action across saddle/cloth/wound objects.
Pan-baked priestly-bread (1Chr 9:31). Hyphenated to mark griddle-cake form distinct from H2471 challah ring-cake.

Pilgrim-festival (Ex 10:9; 12:14; 13:6; 23:14-18; 32:5; 34:18,22,25; Lev 23:6,34,39,41; Num 28:17; 29:12; Deut 16:10,13-16; Judg 21:19; Ezr 3:4; Neh 8:14,18; Ps 81:4; Hos 2:13; 9:5; Amos 5:21; 8:10; Nah 1:15; Zech 14:16-19). Hyphenated to mark cultic-celebration distinct from H4150 mo'ed appointed-time.
Isa 19:17 'land-of-Judah-shall-be-a-terror-to-Egypt'. Hyphenated; standard concordant 'terror'.
Edible-locust species (Lev 11:22; Num 13:33; Ecc 12:5; Isa 40:22; 2Chr 7:13). Hyphenated; distinguished from H697 arbeh swarm-locust and H1462 gob locust-multitude.
Nethinim ancestor (Ezr 2:46). English convention: Hagab. 'Locust'.
Nethinim ancestor (Neh 7:48). English convention: Hagabah. Sub-sense paired with H2286b.
Nethinim ancestor (Ezr 2:45) variant spelling. English convention: Hagabah. Sub-sense paired with H2286a.

Qal: celebrate pilgrim-feast, dance-in-procession (Ex 5:1; 12:14; 23:14; Lev 23:39,41; Num 29:12; Deut 16:15; 1Sam 30:16; Ps 42:5; 107:27; Nah 1:15; Zech 14:16,18,19). Hyphenated to mark cultic-celebration distinct from H8055 samach rejoice.
Hide-place in cliffs (Song 2:14; Jer 49:16; Obad 1:3). Hyphenated to mark crevice-shelter distinct from H4869 misgav stronghold.
Loins-girded for travel/battle (Ex 12:11; 1Sam 17:39; Eze 23:15). Hyphenated to mark belt-fastened-state distinct from H2290a chagor noun.
Warrior's-sash (1Sam 18:4; 2Sam 18:11; 1Kgs 2:5; 2Kgs 3:21). Hyphenated; distinguished from H2290b chagorah female-belt.
Worn around hips/loins (Gen 3:7 fig-leaf-aprons; 2Sam 18:11; 1Kgs 2:5; Isa 3:24; Prov 31:24). Hyphenated to mark hip-cloth distinct from H2290a chagor warrior-belt.
Son of Gad (Gen 46:16; Num 26:15). English convention: Haggi. 'Festal'.
Post-exilic prophet (Hag 1:1,3,12,13; 2:1,10,13,14,20; Ezr 5:1; 6:14). English convention: Haggai. 'Festive-one'.
Levitical-temple-divisional reference paired with Iddo. Hyphenated to mark Levitical-divisional aspect distinct from H2292a prophet.
Levite (1Chr 6:30). English convention: Haggiah. 'Festival-of-YH'.
Mother of Adonijah (2Sam 3:4; 1Kgs 1:5,11; 2:13; 1Chr 3:2). English convention: Haggith. 'Festal'.
Daughter of Zelophehad (Num 26:33; 27:1; 36:11; Josh 17:3). English convention: Hoglah. 'Partridge'.
Eze 33:30 'one-with-other'; rare contracted form cognate with Aramaic chad. Hyphenated to mark joint-singular.
Aramaic numeral-one (Dan 2:9,31,35; 3:19; 6:2; 7:5,16; Ezr 4:8; 5:13; 6:2). Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix.
Sharp-edged (Ps 57:4; Prov 5:4; Isa 49:2; Eze 5:1). Standard concordant 'sharp'.
Qal/Hi: of edge or pursuit (Hab 1:8 sharper-than-evening-wolves; Prov 27:17 iron-sharpens-iron; Eze 21:14,15,16). Hyphenated; family with H2299.
Hithpael; Gen 49:6 'with-their-assembly let-not my-honor be-united'. Hyphenated to mark reflexive-joining distinct from H3161 yachad join.
Son of Ishmael (Gen 25:15; 1Chr 1:30). Hyphenated to distinguish from Edomite Hadad-kings (H1908). English convention: Hadad.
Qal/Pi: be-glad (Ex 18:9 Jethro; Job 3:6; Ps 21:6). Standard concordant 'rejoice'.
Job 41:30 'sharp-potsherds-under-Leviathan'. Hyphenated to mark intensive-form of H2299 chad.
Festal-cult-joy (1Chr 16:27; Neh 8:10 'joy-of-YHWH-is-your-strength'). Hyphenated; distinguished from H8057 simchah broader-joy.
Aramaic; Ezr 6:16 dedication-joy. Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix.
Aramaic; Dan 2:32 chest-of-silver in image-statue. Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix.
Benjamite town (Ezr 2:33; Neh 7:37; 11:34). English convention: Hadid. 'Sharp'.
Isa 38:11 'land-of-the-living'; rendering follows root chadal cease — i.e. 'world-where-things-cease'. Hyphenated to mark cease-state.
Adjective from chadal (Ps 39:5 transient; Isa 53:3 forsaken-of-men; Eze 3:27). Hyphenated to mark dual ceasing/abandoned aspect.
Ephraimite chief's father (2Chr 28:12). English convention: Hadlai.
Prickly hedge-plant (Prov 15:19; Mic 7:4). Hyphenated to mark stinging-bramble distinct from H6975 qotz thorn.
Eden-river and Daniel's-vision-river (Gen 2:14; Dan 10:4). Hyphenated to mark Hebrew-name-and-classical-equivalent; English convention KJV Hiddekel, modern Tigris.
Eze 21:14 sword 'enters-into-secret-chamber'. Hyphenated to mark penetrating-into-room aspect; family with H2315 cheder chamber.

Bedchamber, storeroom, innermost-room (Gen 43:30; Ex 7:28; Deut 32:25; Judg 3:24; 15:1; 16:9,12; 2Sam 4:7; 13:10; 1Kgs 1:15; 20:30; 22:25; 2Kgs 6:12; 9:2; 11:2; 2Chr 18:24; 22:11; Ps 105:30; Prov 7:27; 18:8; 20:27,30; 24:4; 26:22; Song 1:4; 3:4; Isa 26:20; Joel 2:16). Hyphenated to mark interior-private-room distinct from H1004 bayit house.
Syrian region (Zech 9:1). English convention: Hadrach.
Pi: make-new, renew (1Sam 11:14; 2Chr 15:8; 24:4,12; Job 10:17; Ps 51:12; 103:5; 104:30; Isa 61:4; Lam 5:21). Standard concordant 'renew'.
Wife of Shaharaim (1Chr 8:9). Hyphenated. English convention: Hodesh.
Judean lowland-town (Josh 15:37). English convention: Hadashah. 'New-place'.
Aramaic; Ezr 6:4 'new-house'. Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix; cognate Heb H2319.
Aramaic Pael: explain, interpret, make-known (Dan 2:4,6,7,9,10,11,16,24,27; 4:2; 5:7,12,15,17). Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix.
Qal: become-liable (Dan 1:10 'endanger-my-head'). Hyphenated to mark debt-liability action.
Eze 18:7 'restore-pledge-of-debt'. Standard concordant 'debt'.
Place north of Damascus where Abram chased Chedorlaomer (Gen 14:15). English convention: Hobah.
Qal: trace-circumference (Job 26:10; Isa 44:13 mark-with-compass). Hyphenated to mark circling-action distinct from H2329 noun.
Job 22:14 'circle-of-heavens'; Prov 8:27; Isa 40:22 'circle-of-the-earth'. Hyphenated to mark spherical-arc distinct from H1754 dur cycle.
Qal: put-forth-riddle (Judg 14:12,13,16; Eze 17:2). Hyphenated to mark riddle-posing distinct from H2420 chidah riddle-noun.
Pi: announce, set-forth (Job 15:17; 32:6,10,17; 36:2; Ps 19:3). Hyphenated; cognate Aramaic H2324.
First-woman 'mother-of-all-living' (Gen 3:20; 4:1). Hyphenated; English convention Eve preserves the chayah/life-root meaning in toelichting.
Small tent-hamlet (Num 32:41; Deut 3:14; Josh 13:30; Judg 10:4). Hyphenated to mark nomadic-encampment distinct from H6727 chatser settled-village.
Settlement-cluster of Jair (Num 32:41; Deut 3:14; Judg 10:4). Hyphenated; English convention KJV/ESV Havvoth-jair.
Regional variant of H2334; the territorial designation in 1Kgs 4:13; 1Chr 2:23. Hyphenated to mark broader-territorial sense.
Seer/prophet whose record is cited (2Chr 33:19). English convention: Hozai. 'Seers'.
Thorny-bush (1Sam 13:6; 2Kgs 14:9; 2Chr 25:18; 33:11; Job 31:40; 41:2; Prov 26:9; Song 2:2; Hos 9:6; Isa 34:13). Hyphenated to mark thicket-bramble distinct from H6975 qotz pricking-thorn.
Variant rock-cleft hapax. Standard concordant 'crevice'.
Aramaic Pael; Ezr 4:12 'foundations-are-laid'. Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix; cognate Heb H2339 chut thread.

Twisted-line (Gen 14:23; Josh 2:18,21 scarlet-line; Judg 16:9,12; 1Kgs 7:15; Ecc 4:12 threefold; Song 4:3; Jer 52:21; Eze 40:3). Hyphenated to distinguish from H2256a chevel rope and H4865 mishbetsah braid.
Land of Eden-circuit and southern Arabian region (Gen 2:11; 10:7,29; 25:18; 1Sam 15:7; 1Chr 1:9,23). English convention: Havilah.
Sub-sense; Job 39:1; Ps 51:7. Hyphenated to distinguish bringing-forth-aspect from H2342a writhing-travail.
Son of Aram (Gen 10:23; 1Chr 1:17). Hyphenated. English convention: Hul.

Granular-shore-particles, frequent metaphor for innumerability (Gen 22:17; 32:13; 41:49; Ex 2:12; Deut 33:19; Josh 11:4; Judg 7:12; 1Sam 13:5; 2Sam 17:11; 1Kgs 4:20,29; Job 6:3; 29:18; Ps 78:27; 139:18; Prov 27:3; Ecc 1:11 (Heb); Isa 10:22; 48:19; Jer 5:22; 15:8; 33:22; Hos 1:10; Hab 1:9; Zech 9:3). Standard concordant 'sand'.
Sheep-coat color (Gen 30:32,33,35,40 — speckled-and-brown). Hyphenated to mark dark-coat.

Qal: take-compassion, refrain-from-harm (Gen 45:20; Deut 7:16; 13:8 (Heb 13:9); 19:13,21; 25:12; 1Sam 24:10; Neh 13:22; Isa 13:18; Jer 13:14; 21:7; Eze 5:11; 7:4,9; 8:18; 9:5,10; 16:5; 20:17; 24:14; Joel 2:17; Jonah 4:10,11; Ps 72:13). Hyphenated to mark mercy-with-restraint distinct from H2603 chanan show-favor.
Coastal-haven (Gen 49:13; Deut 1:7; Josh 9:1; Judg 5:17; Jer 47:7; Eze 25:16). Hyphenated to mark littoral-edge distinct from H7097 qatseh end.
Benjamite (Num 26:39). English convention: Hupham.
Gentilic of Hupham (Num 26:39). English convention: Huphamite.
Civic-aristocrat (1Kgs 21:8,11; Neh 2:16; 4:14,19; 5:7; 6:17; 7:5; 13:17; Ecc 10:17; Isa 34:12; Jer 27:20; 39:6). Hyphenated to mark high-birth-class distinct from H8269 sar prince-official.
Court-cloth (Esth 1:6; 8:15). Hyphenated; distinguishes from H948 buts byssus and H8336 shesh fine-linen.
Multiple persons including Moses' aide on hill (Ex 17:10,12; 24:14; 31:2; 35:30; 38:22; Num 31:8; Josh 13:21; 1Kgs 4:8; 1Chr 2:19,20,50; 4:1,4; 2Chr 1:5; Neh 3:9). English convention: Hur.
Isa 19:9 'they-that-work-in-fine-flax-and-they-that-weave-networks-shall-be-confounded'. Hyphenated.
Earth-cavity (1Sam 14:11; Job 30:6; Isa 11:8; 42:22; Nah 2:13). Hyphenated to mark cavity-recess distinct from H4631 me'arah cave-dwelling.
Qal: turn-white from fear (Isa 29:22 'his-face-shall-not-now-wax-pale'). Hyphenated to mark blanching-aspect.
Aramaic; Dan 7:9 'garment-white-as-snow'. Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix.
Gadite ancestor (1Chr 5:14). English convention: Huri.
David's mighty man, possibly variant of Hiddai (1Chr 11:32; cf 2Sam 23:30). English convention: Hurai.
Person and king of Tyre, variant of Hiram (1Chr 8:5; 2Chr 2:3,11,12; 4:11,16; 8:2,18; 9:10,21). English convention: Huram.
Region east of Jordan (Eze 47:16,18). English convention: Hauran. 'Black-hollow'.
Sub-sense; Ecc 2:25 'who-can-eat-and-enjoy'. Hyphenated to mark sensory-aspect distinct from H2363a hastening.
Judahite ancestor (1Chr 4:4). English convention: Hushah.
Archite friend of David (2Sam 15:32,37; 16:16,17,18; 17:5,6,7,8,14,15; 1Kgs 4:16; 1Chr 27:33). English convention: Hushai.
Wife of Shaharaim sent away (1Chr 8:8,11). Hyphenated. English convention: Hushim.
Son of Dan (Gen 46:23). Hyphenated. English convention: Hushim.
Edomite king (Gen 36:34,35; 1Chr 1:45,46). English convention: Husham.
Engraved-stamp (Gen 38:18,25; Ex 28:11,21,36; 39:6,14,30; Hag 2:23; Song 8:6; Job 38:14; 41:15). Hyphenated to mark stamping-instrument distinct from H2856 chatam to-seal verb.
Asherite (1Chr 7:32; 11:44). English convention: Hotham.

King of Aram-Damascus, anointed by Elijah's commission (1Kgs 19:15,17; 2Kgs 8:8,9,12,13,15,28,29; 9:14,15; 10:32; 12:17,18; 13:3,22,24,25; 2Chr 22:5,6; Amos 1:4). Hyphenated. English convention: Hazael. 'Mighty-One-has-seen'.
Sacrificial-breast-cut, priest's-portion (Ex 29:26-27; Lev 7:30-34; 8:29; 9:20-21; 10:14-15; Num 6:20; 18:18). Hyphenated to mark cultic-share distinct from H7699 shad breast.
Son of Nahor (Gen 22:22). English convention: Hazo. 'Vision'.
Aramaic; Dan 2:19,28; 4:5,9,18; 7:1,2,7,13,15; Ezr 4:13. Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix.
2Chr 9:29 'visions-of-Iddo'. Hyphenated to mark recorded-vision-document.
Aramaic; Dan 4:8,17,20 'visibility-extends'. Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix.
Isa 21:2; 28:18; 29:11; Dan 8:5,8; 11:6. Hyphenated to mark prominent-appearance distinct from H2377 chazon prophetic-revelation.
Levite of Shimei's family (1Chr 23:9). English convention: Haziel. 'Mighty-One-has-seen'.
Judahite ancestor (Neh 11:5). English convention: Hazaiah. 'YH-has-seen'.
Aramean king-grandfather of Ben-Hadad (1Kgs 15:18). English convention: Hezion. 'Vision'.
Night-or-prophet-vision (2Sam 7:17; Job 4:13; 7:14; 20:8; 33:15; Isa 22:1,5; Joel 2:28 (3:1 Heb); Zech 13:4). Hyphenated to mark intense-divine-revelation distinct from H2377 chazon prophetic-vision.
Storm-flash (Job 28:26; 38:25; Zech 10:1). Hyphenated to mark electrical-flash distinct from H1300 baraq lightning.
Unclean-pig (Lev 11:7; Deut 14:8; Ps 80:13; Prov 11:22; Isa 65:4; 66:3,17). Hyphenated.
Priestly division-head and covenant-signer (1Chr 24:15; Neh 10:20). English convention: Hezir.
Variant; 2Sam 3:1; Eze 2:4 'stiff-of-face'; Eze 3:7,8,9. Hyphenated to mark firmness-rigidity distinct from H2389 chazaq overall-strength.
Noun: strength-of-grip (Ex 13:3,14,16; Judg 16:5,6,9,15; Amos 6:13; Dan 11:6; Hag 2:22). Hyphenated to mark gripping-strength distinct from H2393 chezqah strength-state.
Abstract-strength (1Sam 2:16; 2Kgs 12:13; Isa 8:11; 28:2). Hyphenated to mark stable-firm-state distinct from H2394 chozqah grip.
Forceful-hold (Judg 4:24; 8:1; 1Sam 2:16; 2Kgs 12:13; 2Chr 12:1; 26:16; 28:20; Eze 34:4). Hyphenated to mark coercive-grasping distinct from H2393 chezqah stable-firmness.
Benjamite (1Chr 8:17). English convention: Hizki. 'Strong-of-YH'.

King of Judah, son of Ahaz (2Kgs 16:20; 18:1-20:21; 21:3; 1Chr 3:13,23; 4:41; 2Chr 28:27; 29:1-32:33; 33:3; Prov 25:1; Isa 1:1; 36:1-39:8; Jer 15:4; 26:18,19; Hos 1:1; Mic 1:1; Zeph 1:1). English convention: Hezekiah. 'YHWH-strengthens'.
Captive-ring or ornament (Ex 35:22; 2Kgs 19:28; 2Chr 33:11; Isa 37:29; Eze 19:4,9; 29:4; 38:4). Hyphenated to mark ring-through-flesh distinct from H7165 qeres clasp.
Specific-fault (Gen 20:9; 31:36; Ex 32:21,30,31; 34:7; Num 5:6,7; Lev 4:23,28; 5:13; Ps 32:1; 109:7; Isa 5:18; 6:7; Jer 17:1,3; Lam 3:39; 4:6; Mic 7:19; Zech 14:19). Hyphenated to mark fault-misdeed.
Aramaic; Dan 4:24 'break-off-sins'. Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix.
Qal: gather-or-cut firewood (Deut 19:5; 29:11 (Heb 29:10); Josh 9:21,23,27; 2Chr 2:10; Jer 46:22; Eze 39:10). Hyphenated to mark wood-cutting-action distinct from H1438 gada cut-down.
Prov 7:16 'covered-bed-with-decked-coverings'. Hyphenated to mark embroidered-textile distinct from H4765 marbad coverlet.
Multiple post-exilic men (1Chr 3:22; Ezr 8:2; Neh 3:10; 10:5; 12:2). English convention: Hattush.
Aramaic; Dan 4:27 (Heb 4:24) 'break-off-iniquities'. Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix.
Aramaic; Ezr 6:17. Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix.
Gatekeeper-ancestor (Ezr 2:42; Neh 7:45). English convention: Hatita.
Servant-ancestor (Ezr 2:57; Neh 7:59). English convention: Hattil.
Nethinim ancestor (Ezr 2:54; Neh 7:56). English convention: Hatipha. 'Snatched'.
Isa 48:9 'I-restrain-for-thee'. Hyphenated to mark holding-back-of-judgment.
Qal: catch-suddenly (Judg 21:21 Benjaminite-wife-snatching; Ps 10:9 lion-ambush). Hyphenated to mark sudden-grab distinct from H2388 chazaq grasp-firmly.
Branch-stem (Prov 14:3; Isa 11:1 'rod-out-of-stem-of-Jesse'). Hyphenated to mark sprouting-shoot distinct from H4731 maqqel staff.
Sub-sense; relatives, life-bond (1Sam 18:18 'who-am-I-and-what-is-my-kindred'). Hyphenated to mark relational-life-tie distinct from H2416a alive.
Adjective-variant; same kernel as H2416a alive. Standard concordant 'living'.
Aramaic; Dan 2:30; 4:17,34; 6:20,26; 7:11. Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix.
Aramaic; Dan 2:4; 3:9; 5:10; 6:6,21 'O-king-live-forever'. Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix.
Bethelite who rebuilt Jericho (1Kgs 16:34). Hyphenated. English convention: Hiel. 'Mighty-One-lives'.
Enigma, parable (Num 12:8; Judg 14:12-19; 1Kgs 10:1; 2Chr 9:1; Ps 49:4; 78:2; Prov 1:6; Eze 17:2; Hab 2:6; Dan 8:23). Hyphenated to mark hidden-saying-puzzle distinct from H4912 mashal proverb.
Ex 1:19 'Hebrew-women-are-vigorous'. Hyphenated to mark birth-strong-aspect distinct from H2416a chay alive.
2Sam 20:3 'shut-up-unto-day-of-their-death-in-living-widowhood'. Hyphenated to mark living-bereavement-state.
Qal-variant of chayah; Gen 3:22 'live-forever'; Gen 5:5; Job 7:16. Hyphenated to mark prolonged-living.
City-wall outer-bulwark (2Sam 20:15; 1Kgs 21:23; Isa 26:1; Lam 2:8; Nah 3:8; Obad 1:20). Hyphenated to mark wall-defense distinct from H2428 chayil army-might.
Birth-pang, agonizing-twist (Job 6:10; 15:20; Ps 48:6; 55:4; Jer 6:24; 22:23; 30:6; 50:43; Mic 4:9-10). Hyphenated to mark twisting-pain.
Sub-sense; Job 15:20 'wicked-trembles'. Hyphenated to mark fear-shudder distinct from H2427a birth-pang.
Aramaic; Dan 3:20; 4:35 'army-of-heaven'. Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix.
Ps 48:13 'consider-her-ramparts'. Hyphenated to mark city-wall-fortification.
Place east of Jordan where David defeated Hadadezer (2Sam 10:16,17). English convention: Helam.
Possible scribal-toponym referenced in some Hebrew variants. Hyphenated to mark place-marker; English convention follows H2503 Helez.
Job 41:12 'comely-proportion-of-his-limbs'. Hyphenated to mark gracious-form distinct from H2580 chen favor-noun.
Eze 13:10 'one-built-wall-and-they-daubed-it-with-untempered-mortar'. Hyphenated to mark partition-wall distinct from H2346 chomah city-wall.

Outermost-spatial (1Kgs 6:29-30; 1Chr 26:29; 2Chr 4:9; Eze 10:5; 40:17,19,20,31,34,37; 41:9,17; 42:1,3,7-9,14; 44:1,19; 46:21,22; 44:1; Esth 6:4). Hyphenated to mark exterior-position distinct from H6442 penimi inner.
Adullamite friend of Judah (Gen 38:1,12). English convention: Hirah.
King of Tyre and Tyrian craftsman (2Sam 5:11; 1Kgs 5:1-12; 7:13-45; 9:11-27; 10:11,22; 1Chr 14:1). English convention: Hiram. 'Of-noble-birth'.
Variant of chush; Job 20:2 'my-haste-thoughts-urge-me'. Hyphenated to mark intensified-haste.
Adverbial-quickness; Ps 90:10 'soon-cut-off'. Standard concordant 'speedily'.

Qal/Pi: tarry, wait (2Kgs 7:9; 9:3; Job 3:21; 32:4,11,16; Ps 33:20; 106:13; Prov 20:21; Isa 8:17; 30:18; 64:4 (Heb 64:3); Hos 6:9; Hab 2:3; Zeph 3:8; Dan 12:12). Hyphenated to mark patient-expectation distinct from H6960 qavah hope.
Job 41:1; Isa 19:8; Hab 1:15. Hyphenated to mark angling-implement distinct from H2397 chach nose-hook.
Hill where David hid (1Sam 23:19; 26:1,3). English convention: Hachilah.
Aramaic; Dan 2:12,14,18,21,24,27,48; 4:6,18; 5:7,8,15; Ezr 7:25. Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix.
Father of Nehemiah (Neh 1:1; 10:1). English convention: Hacaliah.
Gen 49:12 'eyes-shall-be-red-with-wine'. Hyphenated to mark wine-darkened-eye-aspect.
Prov 23:29 'who-has-redness-of-eyes'. Hyphenated to mark inflamed-eye distinct from H122 adom red.
Aramaic; Dan 2:20,21,23,30; 5:11,14. Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix.
Father of Jashobeam, one of David's chief-three (1Chr 11:11; 27:32). English convention: Hachmoni. 'Wise-one'.
Pluralis-intensivus form (Prov 1:20; 9:1; 14:1; 24:7; Ps 49:3 (Heb 49:4)). Hyphenated to mark personified-wisdom-form distinct from H2451 abstract-wisdom.
Non-sacred, ritual-ordinary (Lev 10:10; 1Sam 21:4 (Heb 21:5),5 (Heb 21:6); Eze 22:26; 42:20; 44:23; 48:15). Hyphenated to mark non-sacred-distinction distinct from H6944 qodesh holy.
Qal: become-very-ill (2Chr 16:12 — Asa's foot-disease). Hyphenated to mark severe-illness aspect; family with H2470a chalah be-sick.
Pot-scum, corrosion (Eze 24:6,11,12). Hyphenated to mark corrosive-residue.
Wife of Ashhur (1Chr 4:5,7). Hyphenated. English convention: Helah.
David's mighty man (2Sam 23:29). English convention: Heleb.
Asherite town (Judg 1:31). English convention: Helbah.
Damascus wine-region (Eze 27:18). English convention: Helbon.
Incense-ingredient, aromatic-gum (Ex 30:34). Hyphenated to mark aromatic-resin distinct from H3828 levonah frankincense.
Earthly-existence-duration (Job 11:17; Ps 17:14; 39:5 (Heb 39:6); 49:1 (Heb 49:2); 89:47 (Heb 89:48)). Hyphenated to mark transient-world distinct from H2309 chedel cease-state and H5769 olam age.
David's mighty man (1Chr 11:30). English convention: Heled.
Unclean creeping creature (Lev 11:29). Hyphenated to mark burrowing-rodent distinct from other ritually-unclean animals.
Prophetess in Jerusalem-Mishneh, Josiah-oracle (2Kgs 22:14; 2Chr 34:22). Hyphenated. English convention: Huldah. 'Weasel'.
Priest in Joiakim's day (Neh 12:15). English convention: Helkai.

Pi: appease, soften-the-face-of (Ex 32:11; 1Sam 13:12; 1Kgs 13:6; 2Kgs 13:4; 2Chr 33:12; Jer 26:19; Zech 7:2; 8:21,22; Mal 1:9; Ps 119:58; Dan 9:13; Job 11:19; Prov 19:6). Hyphenated to mark face-soothing distinct from H2470a be-sick.

Round-perforated bread (Ex 29:2,23; Lev 2:4; 7:12,13; 8:26; 24:5; Num 6:15,19; 15:20; 1Sam 10:3; 2Sam 6:19; 1Chr 16:3; 23:29; Jer 37:21). Hyphenated to mark perforated-loaf distinct from H3899 lechem bread.
Judean and Moabite town (Josh 15:51; 21:15; Jer 48:21). English convention: Holon.

Assyrian exile-region (2Kgs 17:6; 18:11; 1Chr 5:26). English convention: Halah.
Judean town near Hebron (Josh 15:58). English convention: Halhul.

Substitute-set, exchange (Gen 45:22; Judg 14:12,13,19; 2Kgs 5:5,22,23; 1Kgs 5:14 (Heb 5:28); Job 10:17; 14:14; Ps 55:19 (Heb 55:20)). Hyphenated to mark replacement-relief.
Spoil taken from defeated foe (Judg 14:19; 2Sam 2:21). Hyphenated to mark armor-spoil distinct from H7998 shalal generic-spoil.
Destitute-and-oppressed (Ps 10:8,10,14). Hyphenated to mark hapless-victim distinct from H6041 ani afflicted.
